description: scores/saves/index.json (gitignored runtime save-slot index; no data/ content file pairs with this schema - validate_data skips data/schemas/). Written ONLY by game/core/savegame.py through engine.data_io.write_validated. Lists every save slot's lightweight summary (id, pinned flag, timestamps, round reached) so the Save Files screen can render its list without loading every slot's full body (SaveGamePLAN SG-1).

slots.description: Every save slot's summary, in creation order (oldest first) - the same order FIFO eviction walks.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the autosave that created this slot.

map_id.description: The active map this run was played on.

pinned.description: True if this slot is exempt from FIFO eviction.

round_num.description: The round this save was taken at - always a multiple of 5 in practice (the autosave cadence).

slot_id.description: Unique id; also the stem of scores/saves/<slot_id>.json.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last write to this slot - equals created_at, since a slot is never overwritten by a later autosave (D3: every autosave creates a new slot).

version.description: Document format version. Only 1 exists; a future bump is a schema change.

title: saves_index
